intro: Brother Kristoff prepares a sermon in Stormwind City's Cathedral of Light. For his message on the Fortitude of the Spirit, he seeks a book in Stormwind Keep's Royal Library.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I'm giving a speech on the Fortitude of the Spirit, and I'd like to recite passages from a particular book on metallurgy - "The Stresses of Iron." A copy of this book should be in the Royal Library, within Stormwind Keep. Can you retrieve it for me? If so, then may the blessings of the Light be with you!
The Royal Library is very large, but the head librarian, Milton Sheaf, knows each shelf like it was his own son. Speak to him, he'll retrieve the book for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Metallurgy? Ah yes, we have many books on the subject, and are happy to aid Brother Kristoff with his speech! Now...which particular book was it the good brother needed?
